name: Claude Code Runner
description: Uses Claude Agent SDK as a local provider — delegates all reasoning, tool use, and file editing to the SDK.

port.description: Port for the local bridge server

workDir.description: Ignored: the bridge takes its working directory from the OpenClaw workspace it is started in. Kept so an existing config.json carrying it is not refused.

maxTurns.description: Max agentic turns per request (safety cap, default: 30)

queueMinDelayMs.description: Minimum delay between SDK queries in ms (default: 1000)

queueMaxDelayMs.description: Maximum delay between SDK queries in ms (default: 4000)

maxRetries.description: How many times a transient SDK failure is retried before the request fails (default: 2).

effort.description: Effort level: low, medium, high, max (default: medium)

tools.description: Allowed tools list (default: all claude_code tools)

strictMcpConfig.description: When true (the default), the SDK session uses only the MCP servers given in mcpServers and ignores MCP configuration it would otherwise discover on the filesystem. Set it to false to restore the SDK's own default.

systemPromptMode.description: How the system prompt the caller sends is combined with the Claude Code preset prompt. "replace" (the default) sends the agent's prompt alone. "append" prepends the ~26.6 KB Claude Code preset, i.e. coding-agent identity and instructions to use built-in Bash/Read/Write tools. CLAUDE.md/memory loading and the environment block (today's date) are injected from cwd in BOTH modes and are not affected by this setting. See booqi-app/infra#202.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers passed into the SDK query options as mcpServers. Keyed by server name; each value is a transport object the Agent SDK understands, e.g. { "type": "http", "url": "http://127.0.0.1:3010/mcp" }.
